title: Working Student, Global Oncology Real World Evidence Operational Excellence (m/f/d)
description: Bei Daiichi Sankyo stehen wir vereint hinter einem einzigen Ziel: Das Leben auf der ganzen Welt durch innovative Medikamente zu verbessern. Mit aktiver Innovation seit 1899, Präsenz in mehr als 30 Ländern und über 19.000 Mitarbeitern entwickeln wir bahnbrechende Therapien in der Onkologie, für Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen, seltene Krankheiten und Immunerkrankungen. Im Einklang mit unserer Vision 2030, "ein innovatives globales Gesundheitsunternehmen zu sein, das zur nachhaltigen Entwicklung der Gesellschaft beiträgt", gestalten wir eine gesündere, hoffnungsvollere Zukunft für Patienten, ihre Familien und die Gesellschaft. Purpose of the function We are currently seeking a Working Student to join our Global Oncology Marketing, Access and Pricing (GOMAP) team in our European headquarters in Munich. In this role, you will support the GOMAP Real-World Evidence (RWE) team in driving operational excellence initiatives that enhance the visibility, accessibility, and impact of RWE activities across Daiichi Sankyo's oncology portfolio. You will contribute to the management of RWE knowledge resources, educational initiatives, and impact reporting through cross-functional collaboration with global, regional, and local stakeholders. Munich, fixed-term, 20h/week Roles and Responsibilities Support the planning, coordination, and execution of the RWE Roundtable program, including meeting logistics, content organization, communications, and stakeholder engagement. Assist with the maintenance and continuous improvement of the RWE Roundtable SharePoint site, ensuring that resources, study information, and educational materials are current, accessible, and user-friendly. Assist in coordinating RWE educational and training initiatives, including the development, organization, and distribution of learning materials. Support the compilation and analysis of information for RWE impact reports by collecting examples of how secondary data studies have contributed to evidence generation objectives, publications, scientific communications, and decision-making. Coordinate information gathering across global, regional, and local teams to capture and communicate the impact of RWE and HEOR activities and outcomes. Assist with project management and tracking of key RWE initiatives, helping to ensure timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communications are effectively managed. Assist with wider Global RWE and Global HEOR team projects and initiatives to help deliver successful outcomes. Requirements Currently enrolled in a university program in Germany, with a strong interest in pursuing a career in evidence generation the pharmaceutical industry. Previous experience in the pharmaceutical industry, healthcare, consulting, or life sciences is preferred. Strong interest in project management, operational excellence, and cross-functional collaboration. Highly self-motivated with a proactive, hands-on attitude. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively. Excellent oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated analytical, quantitative, and project management skills. Proficient in Office 365 applications. Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; any further European language is a plus. Personal values aligned with Daiichi Sankyo’s core principles: integrity, collaboration, commitment, and courage, which guide our daily interactions with customers and colleagues. Warum Sie bei uns richtig sind Bei Daiichi Sankyo zu arbeiten, ist mehr als nur ein Job – es ist Ihre Chance, das Leben von Patient*innen zu verbessern. Dieses ehrgeizige Ziel können wir nur gemeinsam erreichen. Deshalb pflegen wir eine Kultur des gegenseitigen Respekts und des kontinuierlichen Lernens, die von Vielfalt und Inklusion geprägt ist. Hier haben Sie die Möglichkeit, sich weiterzuentwickeln, mutig zu denken und Ihre Ideen einzubringen. Sie arbeiten proaktiv und möchten sich für die Bedürfnisse von Patient*innen einsetzen? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt!
